title: ExplainAble-AI
summary: A small project applying SHAP explainability analysis to propagation modeling data, built around a custom synthesizer that subclasses SDV's single-table CTGAN synthesizer and its internal utilities. SDV's sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer and BaseSingleTableSynthesizer classes (alongside the standalone ctgan package) are extended in-code to create a custom, explainable synthetic-data model.
